purpose: Branch-and-fold fixture dramatizing a Divided City disclosure laundry from a civic copyist's bounded viewpoint.
tonal_mode: dry civic noir with humane workplace wit

local_awareness_summary.text: Nara knows the copy room's three routes, document custody, ordinary filing sequence, and the visible relationship among a house forecast, shrine cart request, and garrison guard receipt; she does not know the plan-holder's identity or any divine intent.

Talen owns the lift crew's material account and can inspect, stage, stop, or limit loads inside Sunwall competence; Nara can preserve or transfer records but cannot operate the lift or command the garrison.
The conspiracy survives individual exposure because house patronage, garrison force, protected-lane access, and civic dependence remain real authorities after a cutout or scribe is sacrificed.
source_refs: Kalsa/Spoilers/Institutions/Forecast Evidence and Courts.md#Authored elaboration: disclosure laundries

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective stays with Nara inside the copy room; choices use inspection, copying, locks, messengers, record transfer, and scoped authorization.
Routine tea, pen sharpening, capacity copying, and divided key custody establish ordinary office life before the cutout and garrison apply pressure.

authority_boundaries.text: A forecast remains expert evidence; Nara cannot turn it into a verdict, Talen cannot turn an operating limit into civic law, and the garrison cannot turn protection into Sunwall competence.
No branch proves which god, Projection, or magical influence stands behind a patron, and no character can see a complete future from the joined papers.

object_custody.text: The three leaves begin in separate trays; the ward packet, Sunwall operating leaf, copy chest, two keys, tying cords, safe-conduct token, and any signed activation chain change custody only through explicit actions.

required_semantics.text: Exposure must change this order without dissolving the offices and dependencies behind the conspiracy.
source_refs: Kalsa/Spoilers/Institutions/Forecast Evidence and Courts.md#Authored elaboration: disclosure laundries

required_semantics.text: Every ending must show who controls the office, archive copy, court route, or lift lever, and who pays the remaining cost.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not name an unresolved Prophetic House, city, sector border, armistice, or native office title.
Do not make disclosure automatically abolish tribute, garrison presence, house patronage, or ward dependence.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Three choice layers fold through routine filing and cutout pressure into four priorities with state-gated success and cost endings.

branches.actor_intent: Join the bell interval, beneficiaries, and cord fibers into relationship evidence.
state_basis: Nara can inspect all three records while they are in civic receipt custody.
reviewed_consequences: Raises link_evidence and cell_pressure; enables direct cutout confrontation and strengthens the court ending.

branches.actor_intent: Ask the material owner to create an independent capacity leaf.
state_basis: Talen can attest lift and refuge capacity within Sunwall operation.
reviewed_consequences: Raises talen_trust and load_control; strengthens staged material action.

branches.actor_intent: Place a garrison receipt beyond sponsor custody before pressure arrives.
state_basis: Civic clerks preserve independent copies and serve ward packets.
reviewed_consequences: Raises independent_copy and ward_exposure; strengthens court proof while attracting ward attention.

branches.actor_intent: Keep the connection in memory while making the official room look ordinary.
state_basis: Separate truthful filing is the laundry's camouflage and gives the copyist deniability.
reviewed_consequences: Raises personal_cover and lowers immediate cell_pressure; strengthens the private-cover ending while weakening durable proof.

branches.actor_intent: Use joined records to force a revealing response from Vek.
state_basis: Available only when link_evidence is high enough to name the shared mechanism.
reviewed_consequences: Raises cutout_testimony and cell_pressure; enables a strong testimony ending.

branches.actor_intent: Put received records behind divided civic and Sunwall custody.
state_basis: The copy chest has two physical locks held by separate offices.
reviewed_consequences: Raises independent_copy and cell_pressure while lowering personal_cover.

branches.actor_intent: Spend trust to trigger a real gallery inspection before the hidden plan actuates.
state_basis: Talen can reach the lift gallery by the lower stair and issue an operating warning.
reviewed_consequences: Raises load_control and ward_exposure while spending talen_trust.

branches.actor_intent: Protect Nara's sister through the garrison lane at public cost.
state_basis: Vek offers a bronze lane token as constituency leverage, not proof of loyalty.
reviewed_consequences: Raises personal_cover and ward_exposure while lowering cell_pressure; strengthens the private-cover ending.

branches.actor_intent: Join and transfer the conspiracy relationship for civic review.
state_basis: Success requires strong linkage and a copy beyond sponsor custody.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to court success or cost; stays or narrows this seizure but leaves patron powers intact.

branches.actor_intent: Change the material system so the hidden forecast plan loses its lever.
state_basis: Success requires prepared load authority and enough working trust.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to staged-load success or closure cost; the ward may still pay for delay.

branches.actor_intent: Convert the cutout's exposure into a signed activation chain.
state_basis: Success requires Vek's earlier revealing response.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to testimony success or bargaining backfire; exposes the chain while the offices sacrifice the cutout.

branches.actor_intent: Use the offered leverage to protect family and retain future office access.
state_basis: Success requires enough personal cover assembled through tidy filing or safe conduct.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to family passage or public scapegoating; the laundry captures the load in both variants.

audit.reviewer: Tangle elaborator self-review using the four required Ghostlight reviewer prompts
review_notes: Narrative review split the three-record closeup into its own Ink knot and established Nara's sister and lane routine before the private-cover ending.
Lore review removed an uninspected Oracle Ecology citation, preserved unresolved house, sector, city, date, and divine identities, and confirmed that each authority acts only through its owned layer.
Visual review delayed guard imagery until after the cutout arrives and retained branch-specific visible deltas for every material choice and ending family.

Spatial review confirmed a stable three-route room: court stair rear left, lift stair front right, barred service door on the right wall, central desks and chest between them; a draft scene-set map owns repeat staging.
